action: deflect a continuous longitudinal axis into a bend
divergence: Measured on a bare extruded body, uncut by the envelope: massv2 bend adds 0 m3 (displace) acting on 1 volume(s) (single). The BOOK records this word as displace on single volumes. The two agree on both counts, so the second implementation is a restatement rather than a different word - it may still differ in proportion, which this bench does not measure.

mathematical_basis.reference: Barr, A.H. (1984) 'Global and Local Deformations of Solid Primitives', SIGGRAPH Computer Graphics 18(3), 21-30
mathematical_basis.definition: A circular-arc deformation about an axis: points are mapped onto a cylinder of radius 1/k over a bend region, so a straight prism follows an arc of curvature k. 3ds Max and Maya ship this as the Bend modifier.
mathematical_basis.shipped_as: 3ds Max Bend modifier / Maya nonlinear bend

delivery_contract.why: A unary AST chain, a decompose() != 1 refusal inside every macro, and a maximum_components=1 promotion gate. The reason is written in candidate_analysis.py: a detached piece is no more architectural than a small Lego speck, and split wings or arrays must be joined by an explicit bridge or spine.
delivery_contract.note: So the BOOK record's `multiple` means how many volumes the operative involves, NOT how many bodies come back.

final_reading.text: massv2 delivers -3.5% where a Barr bend preserves volume exactly. Unlike `twist`, more sampling does not help: segments 2, 4 and 6 all measure -3.5%, so this is not the chord between sampled sections. The forward-kinematic chain turns each segment about the joint it shares with the one before, and the loss is constant in the segment count - which points at the joint itself rather than the sampling. Left measured; it needs its own trace.
final_reading.basis: extrude seed on the Uijeongbu parcel, uncut by the envelope
